title: Nisan calendar with Passover (Pesach) and Leviticus 23:11
summary: A one-month calendar of Nisan (days 1–30) with Pesach / Passover marked in red where days 14–22 would be, followed by Leviticus 23:11 on waving the sheaf the day after the Sabbath.

text.text: 11 He is to wave the sheaf before the Lord so it will be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

numbers.note: days in the month of Nisan as shown
day shown after the word PESACH on the Nisan calendar

uncertain: The calendar hides the dates 14-16 under the word PESACH and 18-22 under PASSOVER; only 17 and 23 are visible next to them.
